func_08005018_6C4768.title: Initialize the Miracle Moon reward
func_08005018_6C4768.summary: Initializes Congo’s Miracle Moon reward when its pickup scene is not complete.
behavior: The room 0x0016 reward is placed as entity 0x35F and uses file_30. This initializer assigns native entity identity 0x350 at task +0x5E.
Saved flag 0x0A4 suppresses reward setup when the Moon pickup scene has already finished. Inventory ownership at save +0x254 is a separate value and is not this completion test.
The next callback waits for Congo victory flag 0x12B before the reward appears and enters its idle pickup behavior.
func_08005018_6C4768.exampleExplanation: Observe only a successfully initialized native reward at constructor return. Read the scheduler current-task value in this callback context rather than assuming the first argument register survived initialization.
cautions: Requires the native room placement and file_30 resources; this is not a general collectible constructor.
Do not infer pickup completion from the inventory word alone.
An observation hook is shown; no direct constructor call is required.

func_0800532C_6C4A7C.title: Start the Miracle Moon pickup scene
func_0800532C_6C4A7C.summary: Starts the Moon acquisition scenario and its native player-control ownership.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Initialized native Miracle Moon reward task.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The reward task’s native display object.

behavior: The idle reward selects this callback when pickup begins. Native callback selection writes task +0xC immediately; execution occurs on its scheduled actor update.
Starts scenario 0x71 and acquires the native pickup control state. That scenario writes 1 to the signed 32-bit Miracle Moon inventory field at save +0x254 before its final scene completion.
The later completion callback waits for the scenario to end, releases pickup control and records saved flag 0x0A4.
func_0800532C_6C4A7C.exampleExplanation: Observe the exact native pickup entry without replacing the scenario or changing its player-control state.
cautions: Preserve an already selected pickup callback, even before its entry hook executes.
Do not remove the active reward or set completion flag 0x0A4 while its local scenario still owns player control.
Do not invoke this callback on an idle task merely to grant inventory.

func_080053A4_6C4AF4.title: Complete the Miracle Moon pickup scene
func_080053A4_6C4AF4.summary: Releases native pickup control, records Moon completion and retires the reward.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Native Moon reward whose pickup scenario has started.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The reward task’s native display object.

behavior: Waits until the native scenario program counter is zero. Then releases pickup control, sets packed save flag 0x0A4 through the native flag setter, and sets task status +0x68 remove bit 0x2.
The common native actor post consumes remove bit 0x2 through its normal task cleanup. The completion routine must remain associated with the pickup that acquired player control.
Completion flag 0x0A4 is at save byte +0x14, bit 4, mask 0x10. It is separate from Moon inventory at +0x254 and the Goemon weapon-tier word at +0x0A4.

The actual Congo exit is the file_43 placed actor 0x34B, initialized as 0x23C. Its native wait reads flag 0x0A4, then starts a 120-update opening timer, sound 0x224 and opening animation. The existing portal leads to room 0x28.

The ordinary Congo camera reacts when both 0x0A4 and its separate 0x132 condition are set. It consumes 0x132, views the exit for its native 150-update phase, then waits 20 updates before returning to normal. On later room entry, flag 0x0A4 suppresses the Congo root and skips the camera intro.
func_080053A4_6C4AF4.exampleExplanation: Observe successful completion after native control release and flag mutation, before the ordinary post callback retires the reward. The example does not retain a task pointer or call the completion routine itself.
cautions: This routine releases global pickup control. Do not call it to retire an uncollected reward that never started the scenario.
A saved flag change can activate the exit and camera while a scene is still active; preserve the native completion ordering.
The Congo exit is not the generic locked doorway or the unrelated file_29 rotating-object callback.
